_comment: Maps icon cluster id (from extract.mjs, see pages-icons.json) to an asset under /img/icons/, or the literal '*' for the asterisk symbol. Unmapped clusters render as a faithful monochrome inline SVG reconstructed from the PDF paths. Cluster ids are stable as long as the source PDF is unchanged; re-verify after re-extraction. Identified via shape-match to the asset icons + surrounding-text context.
